views.note: Mutations in “CRC” by protein position, as cBioPortal's mutation tab draws them: one stem per codon (the stored protein start position), its height the number of distinct patient + protein change pairs there. Colour is the codon's dominant mutation type, putative drivers before VUS (driver = OncoKB oncogenic, pinned; the portal also counts hotspots and custom annotations). VUS and germline mutations are included, as they are by default on the portal. A suppression floor of 3 patients per change was applied BY EACH SITE before returning anything, withholding 1,112 mutations.
